notes.title: DEMO PATCH #46 - RITUALS, CARROTS AND FISH
notes.content:
[h1]THE BIG NEW PATCH IS FINALLY LIVE![/h1]
Hey everyone

So its been a longer time than usual for this update, we had to revamp the code a bit again to so we can do some more dynamic stuff with the Villagers. But its finally done. On top of this there's a juicy update with Rituals and Two new Professions, carrots and FISH!! 

Here are the changes for this patch:
[h2]NEW[/h2]
🔹RITUALS- Villagers wont automatically worship you know, You can choose a ritual and what villagers should perform it to boos your village. 
🔹CREATON - A new type to choose in the talent tree that enables a new creation in the world.
🔹CARROTS - A creation that will spawn in the environment and can be used as food 
🔹FISH - A creation that will spawn in the environment and can be used as food 
🔹GARDENING - A profession to automate Carrot planting
🔹FISHING HUT - A new building and profession for workers to catch fish
🔹SLEEP - Villagers will now go to sleep at night unless you tell them to do other things.
🔹TOOLTIPS - Added some more Tooltips to explain some stuff. 
🔹INTRO! - a brand new intro to make the start of the game a bit more exciting
🔹NEW SKILL TREE - total revamped visuals and also added unlockable buildings to the skill tree, also better info on the nodes in the skill tree.
🔹REROLL PRAYERS - You can now use devotion to reroll a prayer.
🔹AUDIO ON BUILDINGS - Clicking on buildings now triggers relative audio 
🔹 LOCALIZATION - added Norwegian, Dutch, Ukrainian, and Romanian. 

[h2]TWEAKS[/h2]
🔹Villagers will finish their tasks before being interrupted by night or eating 
🔹You can now cancel trading in progress 
🔹You can now click on the banner icon to move to it
🔹Visually improved Health bars
🔹Pacing Tweaks, We adjusted the pacing to introduce new things at a better rate
🔹Improved Feedback when leveling up
🔹Removed Request to offer resources, they will only ask for resources now.
🔹You can no longer lift wildlings, only your followers 
🔹Wildlings will automatically join the village and do not have to be lifted
🔹Updated Signs prayer to be 3 instead of 5 signs
🔹Held items are now visualized over everything 
🔹Balanced trade offers from enemy camps 
🔹Improved villager AI to eat in-between tasks instead of interrupting (especially good for traders 😄 )
🔹Other camps will attack you if their attitude is low
🔹You now get XP by interacting with followers other than prayers

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
🔹Tooltips could get stuck
🔹Builders could spawn 0 amount of Resources 
🔹Could not see gifts on a selected villager
🔹 The progress of the villagers prayer is now visible when holding them
🔹UI icon on the trade cart was blank if only asking for resources
🔹 A prayer for a job cannot be for a job they already have
🔹Could lose resource by dropping them on the messenger (if the wrong resource)
🔹Faith would go down on villagers while dead. 
🔹Choosing Orcs would trigger an altar click 
🔹Setting menu panels would overlap
🔹Call on wildlings tutorial could show on any building.
🔹Duplication of corpses by colliding with graves
🔹 The trade post would break if a camp were bought 
🔹Reviving a follower would bug out something that doesn't exist
🔹Fixed some localization panels not scaling properly

Please try all the new stuff and let us know what you think 

[h2]UPCOMING[/h2]
Improved enemy camps

[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
🔹Workers who were bringing resources to their building dropped them when they got shocked and then grabbed new ones (same when dropping them in the storage)
🔹Dead villagers got flipped up-right
🔹Enemies that turned into wildlings as they were electrocuted bugged out
🔹Dead villagers had prayers
🔹Killing messenger on the way home with lightning made them slide along the ground
🔹Killing wildlings made them bug out 
🔹Revived characters got an empty prayer
🔹Walls could be placed in enemy camp

🔹Animal spawner zones ended up in enemy camps

🔹The status of enemy camps was not saved
🔹Grass and bushes don't seem to disappear when you build over them
🔹Unfinished buildings could still be broken by lightning. 
🔹Dropping a corpse underground will leave it dangling.
🔹Carpenters did not seem to repair broken buildings.

notes.title: DEMO PATCH #37 - GIFTS, RACES & FAITH
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone! [/h1]
After many weeks without updates, we are so happy to announce that the new patch is finally here! 
This one is packed with new content and major changes, we're excited to hear what you think. 

[h2]NEW[/h2]
🔹GIFTS! - As you level up now you'll be able to pick a gift that can be granted to one of your followers to make them unique. 
🔹Prayer bubble! - now you'll easily see who has what prayer with an icon above their heads.
🔹FAITH - You can now see how much Faith the followers and enemies have in you.
🔹ELVES & ORCS! - Elves and orcs have joined the world of liftlands and can become your followers! 
🔹CONVERT ENEMIES - enemy camps have elves or orcs instead of goblins and can be converted if their faith in you gets high enough, they will automatically come to your camp.
🔹DESERTING FOLLOWES - if your followers lose faith in you they will leave and join another camp! 
🔹CURSOR TRAIL - player Cursor now is more part of the world
🔹REACTIONS TO INTERACTIONS - Villagers will now increase in faith if you interact close to them and has a react animation

[h2]TWEAKS[/h2]
🔹CONVERTING WILDLINGS - instead of grabbing them and dropping them on the altar you now just have to interact with them and get their faith high enough for them to automatically join you. 
🔹More specific colliders for buildings - will be noticeable when clicking on them and when arrows are shot.
🔹FOOD FROM ANYWHERE - villagers can now eat from anywhere in the world instead of having to run and grab them from inventory. (Experimental)
🔹Tweaked behavior of enemies in their camps to be more spread out and move more slowly. 
🔹IMPROVED PROMPTS - prompts are displayed with the character's faces to recognize them more easily. 

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
🔹Well and composter no longer generate resources when not built. 
🔹Performance improvements 
🔹Picking up retreating enemies caused them to bug out 

Please try it out and let me know what you think!
We're getting closer and closer to having most mechanics in the game, but we still have some way to go. 

[h3]UPCOMING:[/h3]
🔹Alignment and god powers: how you play will shape what you become. 
🔹More gifts and prayers
🔹Trading with enemy camps.

notes.title: DEMO PATCH #35 - NEW GAMELOOP AND COMBAT!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Everyone [/h2]
[h3]So the improved combat is finally here! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931042/e6523c70bd01d22f27599e354ad99b271ea87ac0.png[/img]
[h3]NEW[/h3]
🔹 You no longer get attacked every night, 
🔹 Barracks are changed and can now be built earlier. 
🔹 you can now add and remove characters from the menu when you click on a building. 
🔹 Building destruction - buildings now have health and can be destroyed if damaged. Enemies will 
      target them if there's no villagers nearby
🔹 FAIL STATE. this means that if the altar is destroyed you'll fail and have to restart the game.
🔹 Some more are for level two buildings
🔹 Audio for leveling and collecting faith.
🔹 ENEMY CAMPS: are spread out in the world, and nether you or the villagers can grab resources near 
      them, if attacked they will attack back.
🔹 Goblin archers, finally some ranged enemies.
🔹 Goblins wont attack you at night, instead they will send out messengers at any time and request 
      resources, if you don't give them this they will attack. 
🔹 NEW BUILDING: Banner - You can assign any villager to the banner, you can toggle the states of the 
      banner to set the behavior of the ones assigned to it. You can move the banner and the ones 
      assigned will move to it based on the state. right now there's 2 states, 
      [b]Passive  [/b]- will do their normal tasks until the banner mode is changed.
      [b]Aggressive [/b]- will stay with the banner and attack anything nearby.
      (we're going to add another state that is Defensive where they stay with the banner but only 
      attacks if provoked)

[h3]TWEAKS[/h3]
🔹 Tweaked Leveling speed so it now slower
🔹 Changed a bunch of the costs of buildings and spawn times of items. 
🔹 Archers and soldiers are stronger if you upgrade the building. 
🔹 Improved the spawning of the environment to guarantee a survivable start.
🔹 Made the in-game questions at the start of the game save your answer so it doesn't show every time. 

[h3]FIXED[/h3]
🔹 Archers positioning at the walls are now within range. 
🔹 Characters stopped working
